gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Minn Kota says its own onboard chargers 'are not compatible with single 24V and 36V Lithium Batteries', so the single 24V or 36V lithium battery ChatGPT preferred needs its own 29.2 V or 43.8 V LiFePO4 charger. None of them states either that a QUEST motor's 60 A breaker and draw are more than a 50 A-BMS 36V battery can supply.
standout_why: I read the four pages ChatGPT cited. Minn Kota's Trolling Motor Wiring and Battery Guide covers lead-acid only and says nothing about lithium. Its Deep Cycle Battery Selection page says lithium 'can be used' and that 24/36V motors won't power on below 18 V. Its Lithium Battery Selection page gives the 14.5 V PCL limit, the 85% speed cap for brushed motors and a general warning to match continuous discharge to the motor, with no amp figures in its text. The fourth cited page, Troubleshooting Trolling Motor Power Issues, I did not reopen. None of these says Minn Kota chargers can't charge a single 24V or 36V lithium battery. That exclusion is on Minn Kota's 'Charging Lithium Batteries' page, which appeared as an uncited result in the two 'battery and charger' chats. ChatGPT's answers still paired single 24V/36V LiTime batteries with an unnamed 'lithium-compatible onboard charger', or with a NOCO 2-bank charger at 5 A per bank, and never pointed out the exclusion. None of the results ties the QUEST 60 A rating to a battery's BMS limit. This decides which charger goes in the cart and rules out a 50 A-BMS 36V battery for a 36V QUEST.
kit_items: Battery: Redodo 24V 100Ah LiFePO4. It is one 25.6 V battery with a 100 A BMS, which covers the 60 A max draw and 60 A breaker in the QUEST 24V table. Redodo lists it for 70–100 lb trolling motors, so it suits a 24V motor or a 90/115 QUEST wired for 24 V (90 lb).

Charger: Redodo 29.2V 20A MINI LiFePO4 charger. A single 24V lithium battery can't go on a Minn Kota onboard charger, which Minn Kota rules out itself. Redodo's battery listing names a 20 A (29.2 V) charger for a 5-hour full charge.
Circuit breaker: 60 A, such as the Minn Kota MKR-27 named in the QUEST manual. It is not sold by Redodo, so it can't go in this cart and must be bought separately.

Excluded for a 36V QUEST at full throttle: Redodo 36V 50Ah. Its BMS is rated 50 A continuous, or 60 A for 30 minutes only, which is below the QUEST 36V 60 A rating. Redodo sells no 36V 100Ah to replace it.
